case.name: Ma 2019 Cryogenics 104 closed loop, 4x20 um, measured

reference.citation: Ma Y, Quan J, Wang J, et al. Development of a space 100 mW@5 K closed loop JT cooler. Cryogenics 104 (2019) 102983
reference.note: Precool temperatures are the design values (100/15 K); eta = 0.97 assumed. The quoted 0.16 MPa is the compressor suction; our evaporator pressure is P_sat(5.02 K) = 0.199 MPa, close to the He-4 critical pressure, so this case is sensitive to the return-line pressure drop that the model does not include. Sensitivity: Q_C = 47 mW with T_C = 5.02 K, 78 mW with T_C = T_sat(0.16 MPa) = 4.745 K, 66 mW with eta = 1 and T_C = 5.02 K; measured 102.3 mW.
